name: google-sheets-imports
description: Why is my Google Sheets import stuck, stale or asking for access? Use pasted IMPORTRANGE formulas, error messages, exports or your description of a screenshot to identify access, range, refresh and size problems. Get a corrected formula or a short repair plan with the permission risks explained. No account connection is needed for diagnosis. Setup guidance uses Google Sheets itself; it does not read or change your spreadsheets.
